claim: Patchline ships enterprise SSO and RBAC with audited, least-privilege access to analyses and certificates. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the SSO and RBAC claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make enterprise-sso-rbac-gate`.
